title: Web Novel, Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series The Ordinary Jackpot Debuts on September 10
content:
The Ordinary Jackpot , the live-action series based on the web novel and webtoon of the same name, will premiere on the Korean streaming platform TVING on September 10, with its first two episodes released exclusively on the service.

The series follows Eun-tae Gong (Jun-hyuk Lee), a department manager who has become burned out from his difficult life at work. After winning the lottery, his ordinary life and workplace begin to change.

The Ordinary Jackpot will release two episodes every Thursday at 6:00 p.m. KST on TVING. The series will also premiere on tvN on September 14 at 9:00 p.m. KST, airing Mondays and Tuesdays.

The story of the webtoon, drawn by Ugukjo and written by S.Inha, reads:

After years of hard work, Euntae Gong becomes the youngest team leader at Hongseong International, a major luxury brand licensing company. Instead of the success he envisioned, he's bombarded by office politics and constant pressure. When he unexpectedly wins 1.8 billion won in the lottery, he believes he's finally found an escape, but family troubles and a brand new outlook on life lead him back to the office where he and his unlikely team of underdogs battle the odds to succeed.

Fans can read the English version of the webtoon on WEBTOON , and watch the series on Rakuten Viki .
author: ANN

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Introduces Accessories Included in Expansion Pass DLC Part 2
content:
Nintendo introduced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday the additional new features of the paid Expansion Pass DLC part 2 of Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise . The DLC part 2 includes accessories such as sunglasses, Sylveon ribbon, and bow tie. The DLC will also include Doduo, Skitty, Braixen, and more Pokémon.

The game's DLC part 2 will release later this year.

The game's paid Expansion Pass DLC added the underwater Bubbly Basin town on August 5 as part 1 of the pass, and it will add another town in 2027 as part 3. Purchasing the DLC gives players a bonus Dynamic Ditto print recipe and bonus Rare Pokémetal in-game. The free update that launched with part 1 of the DLC included new Pokémon such as Manaphy, Popplio, Mudkip, Chinchou, Lanturn, Buizel, Corphish, Totodile, Dhelmise, Golisopod, Corsola, Frillish, Lumineon, and Sharpedo.

The free update adds the ability for players to explore and build underwater in existing towns using the new ability to Dive.

The game launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 5 with a Game-Key Card release. Game-Key Cards are physical cartridges that do not actually contain a game, but rather, a key to unlock and play the digital version from Nintendo 's eShop. Koei Tecmo developed the game. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company announced in August the game has sold more than 5 million units worldwide in about four months.

The game introduces Professor Tangrowth, Peakychu, Mosslax, and Smearguru. They are variations of Tangrowth, Pikachu, Snorlax, and Smeargle, respectively.

The battle-focused game Pokémon Champions launched on iOS and Android on June 17. The game debuted for Switch on April 8.

The new Pokémon Winds/Waves games will launch for Switch 2 worldwide in 2027.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Special Episode 63 Ending Featuring "friend" by Kyoko and Haru
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its special Episode 63 ending, featuring the song “friend” performed by Kyoko’s and Haru’s voice actresses, Yuna Inamura and Hitomi Yoshida. The original song by IDOLING!!! was used in Episodes 39-51, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fifth ending featuring “Sakura addiction” by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Nintendo Reveals New Trailer, October 22 Launch for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Game
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , the successor game to Wii Sports Resort , will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22. The company also revealed a new trailer for the game.

The video reveals that in addition to the 12 sports available to play in the game, players can also freely explore the game's setting of Wuhu Island. The video also introduces the game's new Island Crown mode.

The game's 12 sports are:

• Boxing

• Table Tennis

• Archery

• Tennis

• Volleyball

• Bowling

• Basketball

• Golf

• Thumb Wrestling

• Skateboarding

• Power Cruising

• Prop Plane

There is also a Jump Rope minigame for warming up.

Players can use either Sportsmates characters or regular Miis. The game takes place on Wuhu Island, the destination of the original Wii Sports Resort for Nintendo Wii. Wuhu Island also appears in other games such as Wii Fit , Mario Kart 8 Deluxe , and Super Smash Bros. Ultimate .

Nintendo Switch Sports , the successor to Nintendo 's Wii Sports game series, launched in April 2022. The game includes Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara (Swordplay). The game later added Golf and Basketball for a total of eight sports. The game introduced customizable Sportsmates avatars.

The original Wii Sports Resort debuted for Wii in Japan in June 2009 and in the West in July 2009. The game introduced the Wii MotionPlus technology for more accurate motion controls. The game included the following 12 sports: Swordplay, Wakeboarding, Frisbee, Archery, Basketball, Table Tennis, Golf, Bowling, Power Cruising, Canoeing, Cycling, and Air Sports.

Wii Sports debuted for Wii alongside the system's launch as a bundled game in 2006. The game included the following five sports: Tennis, Baseball, Bowling, Golf, and Boxing.

title: Mega Man Dual Override Game Announces Spring 2027 Launch
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Mega Man: Dual Override , a new game in its Mega Man series, will launch in spring 2027. The game will launch for the Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.

The game previously introduced the new character Twinkle Girl as well as returning character Protoman.

The game is collaborating with CAPCOM 's Pragmata game . A skin themed after Mega Man and Roll for Hugh and Diana in Pragmata is scheduled for release in 2026.

The Screen Actors Guild–American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA) union issued an order in March to its members to withhold services from Mega Man: Dual Override after the producer "failed to initiate the signatory process."

Voice actor Ben Diskin announced on Bluesky that he would no longer voice the character of Mega Man. He said he was asked to reprise the character for the new game "only on the condition I work without the protections of a union contract."

CAPCOM recently released Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection , a collection of seven Mega Man Star Force ( Ryūsei no Rockman , or Rockman of the Shooting Star ) games, for Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam on March 27.

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World TV Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Main Trailer, More Cast Members
content:
The website for the second season of the television anime based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series started streaming the anime's main promotional video, and revealed additional returning and new cast members on Thursday. The video previews the opening theme song "Diamond Dust" by Sizuk .

The additional new and returning cast members are (image above from left to right, some character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Sōichirō Hoshi as Lucas Forst (returning)

• Haruka Shiraishi as Lizelotte Eden (returning)

• Ryōhei Kimura as Julius Orphe

• Aoi Koga as Bianca Miller

• Konomi Kohara as Emma Clarke

The returning cast includes:

• Junya Enoki as Ray White

• Iori Saeki as Amelia Ros

• Akira Sekine as Ariane Olgren

• Azumi Waki as Rebecca Bradley

• Kaede Hondo as Clarisse Cleveland

• Yūichirō Umehara as Evi Armstrong

• Kōhei Amasaki as Albert Allium

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Stella White

Miyu Kubota will voice Elisa Griffith. Kubota is replacing Nana Harumura , who retired from voice acting in January due to health reasons. Other new cast members include Hana Hishikawa as Olivia Arnold.

Masahiro Takata is returning to direct the anime, and is also returning to write and oversee the series scripts, and serve as sound director. Zero-G is now animating the series ( Cloud Hearts animated the first season). Other scriptwriters include Tomoko Shinozuka (returning from the first season) and Takahito Ōnishi ( Whisper Me a Love Song , My Happy Marriage ). Mariko Kawamoto ( Magica Wars ) is the new character designer, replacing Makoto Shimojima . Maaya Uchida will perform the ending theme song "Compression :[."

Other staff members include:

• Art Director, Backgrounds: david production

• Art Setting: Junichirō Nishikawa

• Color Design: Fuyuto Muraguchi

• 3D: Cre-p Co., Ltd.

• Director of Photography: Tomomi Saitō

• Editing: Masaki Utsunomiya

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

• Music: Tatsuhiko Saiki, Natsumi Tabuchi

• Music Production: Nichion

• Animation Producer: Takuji Obayashi

• Production Desk: Shōji Yamada

The first season of the television anime premiered in January 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub .

Mikoshiba's original story launched on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2019. The light novel series debuted in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie . Kodansha publishes the light novels in print in Japan.

Norihito Sasaki 's manga adaptation launched on Magazine Pocket in June 2020, and ended in January 2024. The manga's 16th and final volume shipped in April 2024.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?

A Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II : Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru sequel manga launched on May 27. Nao Kagami illustrates the manga and Ishiya Ōgane is in charge of composition. Niconico Manga publishes the manga under Kodansha 's " Suiyōbi no Sirius " label.

title: Manga 'Eat-Man' Gets New Anime Adaptation
content:
Entertainment company Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures opened an official website for a new anime adaptation of Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga, subtitled The Over Order , on Thursday, revealing the lead cast, main staff, teaser visual, and announcement promotional video.

Voice Actor Masashi Ebara ( Dark Gathering ) is reprising his leading role as Bolt Crank.

Staff Director: Shunji Ooga ( Golgo 13 (TV) chief director) Original Design, Script: Akihito Yoshitomi Character Design: Satoshi Hirayama ( Bakumatsu Gijinden Roman ) Studio: Studio Cab

Yoshitomi serialized the action sci-fi manga in Dengeki Comic Gao! magazine from January 1996 to July 2003. Kadokawa published the manga in 19 volumes. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published two volumes before dropping the license.

Yoshitomi later began a sequel manga, Eat-Man: The Main Dish , which was serialized in Shounen Sirius from May 2014 to June 2019. Kodansha published the series in six volumes.

Studio Deen adapted the manga into a 12-episode television anime that aired in Winter 1997. The 12-episode sequel series, Eat-Man '98 , was also produced by the same studio and aired in Fall 1998.

• Toshiba Digital Frontier (now Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures) released the first series on three DVD volumes in Japan, later collected in a limited-edition DVD box in 2001. In 2015, NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan released both television series in a Blu-ray box set.

Synopsis He devours metal and can regenerate any weapon—Bolt Crank, a mysterious adventurer. He speaks nothing of his past and reveals nothing of his purpose. Taking on requests and traveling across the world, countless incidents and fateful encounters await him on his journey. Meetings and farewells, lost memories, things someone has lost, things someone tried to protect, and the truth sleeping somewhere in the world. Carrying untold stories with him, Bolt Crank continues to walk.

Announcement

title: Eat-Man Announces New Anime Project After Nearly 30 Years
content:
EAT-MAN has officially announced a new anime project subtitled The Over Order , coming nearly 30 years since the last installment in 1998. This was confirmed to be the mysterious teaser from last week, when a video featuring screws was released.

You can watch the teaser video below.

A visual was also revealed:

EAT-MAN is a sci-fi manga created by Akihito Yoshitomi, following Bolt Crank, an enigmatic “explorer” who works as a mercenary while traveling from place to place. Bolt has an unusual ability that allows him to consume virtually any object, including screws, metal and weapons, and then reproduce them as weapons.

Yoshitomi launched EAT-MAN in MediaWorks’ Dengeki Comic Gao! in 1996. The manga continued until 2003 and was collected in 19 volumes. The series later returned more than a decade after its original conclusion with EAT-MAN: The Main Dish , which began serialization in Kodansha’s Monthly Shonen Sirius in May 2014. That sequel ran until June 2019 and was collected in six volumes. Kodansha also rereleased the original manga in a 10-volume Complete Edition beginning in 2014.

The manga previously received two TV anime adaptations from Studio DEEN. The first EAT-MAN aired on TV Tokyo from January to March 1997 for 12 episodes, while a second 12-episode series, EAT-MAN ’98 , followed from October to December 1998. Crunchyroll currently streams the original anime adaptation, describing the story: Bolt Crank is an “explorer”–a mercenary who only accepts jobs that fits his moral standards. Even so, explorers like him are rarely trusted, and employment both in getting and also doing the job is hazardous. However, despite the fact Bolt says it’s the only job he’s any good at, he’s also the best explorer around. Moreover, he has a unique ability. He’s able to eat anything at all, and later can reproduce it wholly intact and functional! As an enigmatic man of few words, it’s hard to understand someone who can do something so strange, and who despite it all, just wants to be normal.

As an enigmatic man of few words, it’s hard to understand someone who can do something so strange, and who despite it all, just wants to be normal.

title: Akihito Yoshitomi's Eat-Man Manga Gets New Anime Project
content:
Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures revealed on Thursday the new anime project for Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga titled EAT-MAN The Over Order . The company also revealed a super teaser video, teaser visual, the main staff members, and the return of Masashi Ebara as protagonist Bolt Crank, from the two previous anime adaptations.

Shunji Ōga ( Romance of Three Kingdoms , several Soreike! Anpanman films, Golgo 13 chief director) is directing the new anime at Studio Cab . Original manga creator Yoshitomi is in charge of scripts and original designs, and Satoshi Hirayama ( Cat's Eye season 2, Lupin III specials, Lupin III vs. Detective Conan The Movie ) will adapt Yoshitomi's character designs for animation.

Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures had teased a new project on September 4.

Yoshitomi drew his original Eat-Man manga from 1996 to 2002. Viz Media published part of the original manga in North America. The story follows Bolt Crank, a man who can eat anything and reproduce it in his right hand. The original manga received anime adaptations in 1997 and 1998. Bandai Entertainment released Eat-Man `98 on DVD with an English dub , and Discotek Media released both anime on subtitle-only DVD. Crunchyroll began streaming both anime in 2019.

Yoshitomi launched the Eat-Man The Main Dish manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in May 2014. The six-volume manga ended serialization in 2019.

ADV Manga published Yoshitomi's Ray manga, while Section23 Films released the Ray television anime as well as the Blue Drop anime inspired by Yoshitomi's manga of the same name. Yoshitomi also drew Cyborg 009 Vs. Devilman : Breakdown , the manga adaptation of the Cyborg 009 Vs. Devilman crossover anime. The one compiled volume shipped in April 2016.

title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection Game Launches in 2027
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that the METAL SLUG ULTIMATE COLLECTION game will launch for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 in 2027. The METAL SLUG game's X (formerly Twitter ) account also announced the game's launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam also in 2027. The game's wishlist registration for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam are now open, and wishlist for Switch and Switch 2 will open at a later date.

The game collection includes nine classic METAL SLUG titles, plus its Location Test version.

The METAL SLUG game is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year. The end of the second video above also teases "a new Metal Slug is on the way."

The Metal Slug Tactics game launched for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in November 2024, following several delays. The game was previously slated to debut in 2022, before being delayed to 2023 and then 2024. The game features returning characters Marco, Eri, Fio, and Tarma, as well as the SVX-15D Slugnoid mech.
